admission.justification: Departed-member revision stamping coordinates worklist extraction in writer.py/family_rows.py, candidate-first base fallback in _resolve_examined and _base_revisions, and FamilyRow validation in authoring_rows.py, and only the focused alignment tests distinguish candidate-first base fallback from rejecting departed members or admitting unknown names.

applicability: Examined member entries on family history rows authored through knowledge_write
conditions: Candidate stored invariants are checked first so surviving members stamp their candidate revision

Fallback to reached_family facts.members applies only when the member is absent from candidate stored invariants and carries an integer base revision of at least 1 (rejecting absent, boolean, or non-positive values)
exclusions: Names present in neither candidate stored invariants nor valid reached_family facts.members, which keep the existing not-a-stored-invariant refusal
Stored non-invariant records (such as families or decisions), which remain refused even if named in examined

evidence: Reviewer Code R1 PASS: notes/reports/reviewer/e6d511f4-f94d-5c9b-8cf1-a45e916c3faf/role-launch/261112-BUG-L57-R1-code-verdict.md; the departed member is stamped at its base revision and the survivor at its candidate revision, family_row_open accepts the row, and unknown names, stored non-invariants and missing/non-positive bases keep the present refusal.

statement: For each examined member of a family history row, knowledge_write resolves the member from the candidate's stored invariants first and, only when it is absent there, accepts it at its base revision of 1 or more from the reached_family worklist item's facts.members, refusing names found in neither place with the existing message.
title: Departed family members stamp base revision from reached_family facts
